title: Student Technology Device Program: Schedule of Loan Types
content:
The Student Technology Device Program of Calloway Creek ISD lends district devices under six official loan types. Each loan type fixes the kind of device loaned, the grades it serves, whether the device goes home with the student, and the two family acknowledgments that stand before checkout.

## Schedule

| Loan type | Device loaned | Grades served | Goes home with the student | Parent signature on the device loan agreement required before checkout | Student and parent acknowledgment of the acceptable use policy required before checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | Chromebook | 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Chromebook | 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | iPad | KG, 01, 02 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | Windows laptop | 09, 10, 11, 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Windows laptop | 09, 10, 11, 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | Mobile hotspot | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Conditions of entry by loan type

Each loan type is opened only when its conditions of entry are all met:

- **Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability)** and **Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan**: the student's grade is one of 03 through 12, and the device loan agreement is signed.
- **iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan**: the student's grade is KG, 01 or 02, and the device loan agreement is signed.
- **Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability)** and **Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan**: the student's grade is one of 09 through 12, the student is enrolled in a career and technical education course, and the device loan agreement is signed.
- **Mobile Hotspot Loan**: the household states that it has no home internet, and the device loan agreement is signed.

## Reading the schedule

- The Chromebook loan types serve grades 03 through 12 and the iPad loan type serves KG through 02; the two grade lists do not overlap. The Windows laptop loan types serve grades 09 through 12 and also require enrollment in a career and technical education course.
- Every loan type, the Mobile Hotspot Loan included, goes home with the student and requires both the signed agreement and the acceptable use acknowledgment.
- The loan types that differ only by the Technology Protection Plan (the two Chromebook types, the two Windows laptop types) loan the same device kind to the same grades.

### Hypothetical placements

| Hypothetical student | Learning-device loan types whose grade list admits the student |
|---|---|
| Grade 01 | iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan |
| Grade 06 | Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability); Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan |
| Grade 11, enrolled in a career and technical education course | Chromebook loan types; Windows laptop loan types |
| Grade 11, not enrolled in such a course | Chromebook loan types |
